headline: Mexican Peso Slides 9.6% Ahead of Central Bank Policy Decision
summary: The Mexican peso depreciated by approximately 9.6% against the US dollar between September 4 and October 23. Currency strategists at ING project USD/MXN trading near 19.00–19.10 without hawkish guidance from Banco de México.
why: The Mexican peso is one of the most liquid emerging market currencies. Monetary policy divergence between Banxico and the Federal Reserve influences cross-border carry trades.

impacts.name: Mexican Peso
impacts.why: Anticipation of Banxico policy moves and market repositioning triggered a 9.6% drop against the dollar.

why_moved: The peso fell nearly 10% against the dollar in the weeks leading up to Banxico's November 5 interest rate decision.
